items.en: OCR of scanned pages has its own model setting, so you can use a cheaper model than the one for images.
items.zh: 扫描页的 OCR 有了单独的模型设置，可以用比读图更便宜的模型。

items.en: Self-hosted servers read scanned PDFs and photos on their own with PaddleOCR (also in Docker on a Mac), without calling any AI model, and each user can pick the OCR model in settings. A model downloads the first time it is needed, and you can watch its progress.
items.zh: 自托管的服务器可以用 PaddleOCR 自己识别扫描版 PDF 和照片（Mac 上的 Docker 也可以），不需要调用任何 AI 模型；每个用户都可以在设置里选择 OCR 模型。模型在第一次用到时下载，可以看到下载进度。
